title: 微课堂业务原理图候选
purpose: 供用户挑选 README 业务原理总览图，五张均展示学习目标、拆分小知识点、每天 10 分钟多形式学习、定时复习和认知地图。

adjustments.purpose: 校正流程箭头，确保按学习目标、拆分知识点、微课堂学习、定时复习、认知地图的顺序阅读。
adjustments.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram edit. Edit the supplied Chinese hand-drawn 微课堂 business overview image with ONE narrowly targeted correction to its workflow arrows. Preserve the entire composition, illustration style, title, all wording, every object and all five step positions.
The correct primary path MUST be 01→02→03→04→05. Currently a curved teal arrow directly connects the top-left “01 学习目标” to central “03 每天 10 分钟微课堂”, wrongly skipping step 02.
Remove ONLY that 01-to-03 bypass arrow and naturally restore its paper background. Keep the existing downward 01-to-02 arrow. Add a clearly visible short teal right-pointing arrow from the yellow “本次学习：知识点 B” note in step 02 into the central open learning book of step 03. Place it in the small clean gap between that yellow note and the left edge of the central notebook, without covering any text. Keep the existing 03→04, 04→05 and dashed 04→03 review return loop. No other changes. Do not add any extra labels. Preserve full-size landscape output and all accurate Chinese typography.

images.name: 学习旅程
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset: one complete, richly expressive Chinese explanatory illustration for the README of 微课堂, a personal microlearning application. A standalone landscape image, approximately 16:9, high resolution, crisp and readable when displayed at 1000 pixels wide. The image must explain the ENTIRE business journey, not just one step. Render one image only.
Core flow: learning goal → break into small knowledge points → daily 10-minute microclass using varied learning forms → scheduled adaptive review → build a personal cognitive map. Learning and review repeat, and the map develops over time.
All visible text must be accurate simplified Chinese. Use large professionally typeset Chinese fonts, not tiny illegible filler. Include an integrated prominent title. Place the five numbered step headings along one unmistakable visual path. Give the 10-minute learning part the most space. The picture should be expressive and full of meaningful illustrations, while immediately understandable.
Exact title: “微课堂：从学习目标到认知地图”
Exact five step headings, sequential, each appears once:
“01 学习目标”
“02 拆分小知识点”
“03 每天 10 分钟微课堂”
“04 定时复习”
“05 形成认知地图”
Support text under step 1: “明确想学会什么”
Support text under step 2: “把大目标拆成小步”
Step 3 contains SIX distinct illustrated learning activities labeled exactly: “讲解” “图解” “类比” “练习” “反馈” “追问”. Make these activities legible and prominent, integrated into the main scene rather than a tiny footnote. Feature a clear clock reading “10 分钟”.
Support text under step 4: “按掌握情况调整间隔”. Depict repeated review without any numerical dates or fixed day intervals. A secondary lighter loop should flow from review back toward learning, while the main forward path continues to the map.
Step 5 illustrates learned knowledge points becoming connected, with three clearly legible map states labeled “已掌握”, “待巩固”, “下一步”. Include the short caption “建立知识联系”.
Small unobtrusive footer: “业务原理示意”.
No extra textual claims. Do not promise guaranteed mastery or mastering an entire subject in ten minutes. No streaks, points, rewards, course paywalls, video or audio formats, code architecture, UI browser chrome, fake interactive controls, screenshots, watermark, unnecessary English, or scientific numeric graphs. A map is conceptual, not a claim that the application currently has a spatial network UI. Keep all five stages present with correct order; show readable text and arrowheads. Leave clean generous outside margins.

Art direction:
Style: an exquisite illustrated editorial learning journey, warm white paper, rich dark teal with restrained amber and sage, clean dark Chinese typography. Friendly flat illustration with delicate paper depth and highly polished simple shapes; calm, substantial, suitable for a project homepage.
Composition: an expansive left-to-right illustrated journey along a single gently curving teal ribbon. Five landmarks in order, no rigid row of boxed cards. Step 1 is a learner's goal note and a target; step 2 is one large learning note visibly branching into smaller concept slips; step 3 is the largest central learning island, featuring an open notebook, the clock, and six compact illustrated learning activities around it in a clear 2-by-3 formation. Step 4 has a calendar, repeated cards, and the subtle return arrow. Step 5 culminates in a beautifully linked cluster of knowledge nodes with readable state labels. Put headings near their landmarks; ensure the map is the visual destination. Large title aligned upper left. No landscape scenery unrelated to learning. Visual hierarchy: title, connected 5-step story, six learning modes, small review loop. A confident composition with lots of meaningful detail and excellent scanability.

Style: premium miniature isometric paper-and-ceramic learning workshop, delicate dimensional modeling, matte surfaces, restrained teal, ivory, warm golden accents, soft directional studio lighting on clean ivory background. Sophisticated crafted infographic, not a toy amusement park.

Art direction:
Style: refined botanical knowledge-growth illustration, beautiful ink lines with restrained watercolor and crisp editorial typography, warm cream paper, emerald and teal foliage, soft amber learning accents. Visually rich, intellectual, calm. Growth is a visual metaphor only.
Composition: a large knowledge tree spanning the landscape frame, with a very readable 01→02→03→04→05 progression climbing from lower left to upper right. Art direction:
Style: masterfully composed hand-drawn visual notes / sketchnote infographic, warm white lightly textured paper, confident dark ink outlines, teal and mustard marker accents, lightly imperfect drawn objects but perfectly legible Chinese display lettering. Welcoming, smart, rich in explanatory detail; visually an illustrated learning notebook, not a plain slide template.
Composition: an open panoramic sketchbook-style page without physical book gutter obscuring the content. One clearly labeled hand-drawn arrow path goes from 01 at upper left to 02 at lower left, then to large 03 in the middle, 04 upper right, and 05 lower right. Keep the arrow direction unmistakable. Step 1: goal thought bubble and target; step 2: a page broken down into small numbered concept sticky notes, showing one becoming this session's focus; step 3: a large hand-drawn timer, open learning page, and six distinct substantial mini sketches with exact learning-form labels, occupying the center as the hero. Step 4: calendar and recurring cards, with a return arrow to learning. Step 5: the learner's connected concept network with visible three learning states and caption. Add meaningful line-art book, pencil, diagram and thought-bubble motifs attached to the appropriate activities. No meaningless doodles or motivational slogans. Title appears large across the top, clearly separate from the sketch flow. Leave breathing room around all text, maintain readable captions and plentiful meaningful visuals.
